summary:
M.E.M.S. (Martian Exploration & Mapping System), developed by ARES-X Vanguards, is an interactive platform for exploring Mars and studying potential surface missions. It brings together NASA map layers, twenty destination profiles, Jezero Crater research, terrain analysis, route comparisons, and mission-planning tools. PHOBOS helps visitors understand the project through conversational answers. The website clearly distinguishes sourced data, calculated results, and educational simulations, making Mars exploration accessible while explaining the limits of its information. 
BY TEAM ARES-X VANGUARDS
details:
What it does
ARES-X is a Martian exploration and mapping system. Users explore a Mars map covering ten key regions, with elevation, slope, and route tools built on MOLA terrain data. It works in English, Hindi, and Arabic. Phobos is an AI assistant that answers questions about regions and routes and guides users through the site.


Benefits
Makes Mars terrain data easy to see and understand.
Helps compare routes and spot hazardous terrain.
Free to use in a browser, in three languages.
Intended impact
To make Mars exploration easier for students and the public to understand, and to show how mapping and AI can support mission planning.


Tools used
Website built on Base44
Phobos AI assistant, designed with ChatGPT
MOLA elevation data
A physical Jezero relief model with QR codes linking to the site
What makes it creative
Mapping, an AI assistant, and a physical model work together.
The QR codes connect the physical model to the digital site.
Hindi and Arabic support makes it more inclusive.


What our team considered
Accuracy, by using real terrain data
Route safety, including slope and hazards
Accessibility, with multiple languages and a simple interface
Honesty, by labeling anything simulated
